capabilities: sort tag suggestions by frequency of use across the vault
sort tag suggestions by recently added and saved tags
sort tag suggestions alphabetically using the Japanese locale collator
cycle sort modes with Alt+S on desktop
keep a history of the 500 most recently used tags
disambiguation: Does not suggest new or related tags; it only reorders the candidates Obsidian's native tags field already shows.
extras: Not yet in the official Community directory; installed from GitHub releases or BRAT. Mobile support is experimental and off by default. Wraps undocumented Obsidian APIs (AbstractInputSuggest, private multiselect members), so sorting may stop on Obsidian updates; exact-version gates disable sorting and restore native suggestions when shapes change.
intentEvidence: Sort candidates inside Obsidian's standard in-document tags Properties field.
problem: Obsidian's native tag suggestion list has a fixed ordering, so users cannot pull frequently used or recently added tags to the top when filling the tags property.

relations.evidence: use BRAT's frozen-version command with repository masavo/obsidian-related-tag-suggestions

summary: Tag-suggestion sorter that reorders Obsidian's native tags property candidates by frequency, recently added tags, or name.
